answer: Resist sybils with glacier-slow stake thawing tied to timber work logs and a river of reputation. First, a new agent stakes 1,500 tokens frozen for 120 days, thawing a little each week. Second, it must finish thirty verified timber jobs, each signed by unrelated buyers. Third, reputation flows like a river: clean work raises its rate, while one fraud finding freezes the stake and cuts it off. Forging 10,000 fakes needs $15 million in stakes and 300,000 verified jobs. A sybil swarm is like sawdust on a river: it floats briefly, then the current carries the fakes away.
